notes.title: Update 1.0.2.2
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30831037/9a44a88cb05798735444e4aab52a994ea692beab.png

Update 1.0.2.2

Swordsman armor has been reduced from 2 to 1.
Attack "Troll" increased from 1 to 2.
Attack "Tribe Warrior" reduced from 2 to 1.
The "Barricade" health points of the "Engineer" creature are reduced from 6 to 4.
Health points "Carnivorous Plant" reduced from 4 to 3.
The cost of the "Grow a Plant" ability has been reduced from 3 to 2.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30831037/fc2b190a88d4b1e044d0b89f664d28aef6a9084a.png

Added bonus for defeat if the duration of the game exceeds some time.

The zoom in learning is disabled.

Fixed crashes when the sound engine was loaded incorrectly.
Fixed crashes with incorrect messages in the chat.
Fixed crashes when leaving the game scene.
Fixed some bugs that prevent the correct start of the game.
Fixed crashes when an incorrect request for a duel.

Fixed the description of "Sirin" in the English version of the game.
The message "Miss" is replaced by "Immunity", so as not to confuse players anymore.
Fixed a loss of the deck when leaving the match, if the match was started during the assembly of the deck.

Many small changes.

notes.title: Bugfix 31 October
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30831037/442f858bb41cf55810cb6fda6986cbb7562530c1.png

Update without changing version.

Automatic error reporting has been implemented. If the game crashed, when you restart it, you will be asked to send information to the developers.

Fixed updating of the list of players and its layout problems.

Fixed crash if the player incorrectly downloaded the avatar.

Fixed crash when downloading the game, when the incorrect loading of sounds.

Fixed a message about an unsuccessful order. Before that, it was not shown or was shown to the wrong player.

Fixed crash when using buttons in watching the game through an observer.

Fixed a crash when requesting a duel, when the player was unable to process the request.

Fixed crash when sending an empty message to the chat.

Fixed crash if the player's nickname in the chat does not contain any characters.

Optimized the launch of the game under the 64-bit version of the operating system.

notes.title: Release is coming!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30831037/b7f2871793c37f5a4039f53fd6562b1b01750f72.png

A big hello to all those who found us among the many other games in the system. We do not have advertising budgets, but we really want more and more of us. Very soon there will be a launch of the game, which we have been waiting for so long. We believe that our game will please you and you will become an active participant in it.

Your opinion about the game is very important to us. We will try very hard to please the preferences of players and timely respond to the found shortcomings. If suddenly your game will prevent the error in the game, which we could not find during the testing. We ask you to write about this on the forum.

Soon see you in the game arena. All our developers will play with you!
